checks.title: Buy now, pay later shown near the price
Shipping cost is clear up front
checks.detail: Nothing on the home or product page says what delivery costs. Surprise shipping at checkout is the most common reason carts are abandoned.

checks.title: Customer reviews on products
checks.detail: No product reviews found. A reviews app (Judge.me has a free plan) lets real customers vouch for you. We won't add reviews for you — they have to be real.

checks.title: Returns and 'Australian business' are easy to see
checks.detail: Nothing says the business is Australian or ships locally. A slim bar under the header fixes both.

checks.title: Enough product photos
checks.detail: 7 of 12 products have fewer than 3 photos (e.g. "RedBack LA 41 Inch Bodyboard - Sky Blue"). Shoppers can't touch the product; extra angles and a photo in use stand in for that.

checks.title: Add to cart stays in reach on phones
checks.detail: The product page has a sticky add-to-cart.
